title: Microsoft Purview: auto-labeling ceiling for SharePoint and OneDrive rises to 500,000 files a day (GCC, GCC High, DoD)
summary: Hold for correction of the licensing advice. The cited Learn table assigns the listed E5 Compliance and standalone Azure Information Protection P2 entitlements to client-side labeling, not service-side policies; the briefing also gives an unverified P2 add-on route. The roadmap facts, throughput ceiling and policy controls are supported.

claims.claim: Set-AutoSensitivityLabelPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AddSharePointLocation <site URLs> adds SharePoint locations to an auto-labeling policy.
claims.quote:
Set-AutoSensitivityLabelPolicy -Identity "Main PII" -AddSharePointLocation "https://my.url1","https://my.url2" -AddOneDriveLocation "https://my.url3","https://my.url4"
This example adds the specified URLs to the SharePoint and OneDrive locations

claims.claim: AddOneDriveLocation adds included OneDrive sites identified by URL.
claims.quote: The AddOneDriveLocation parameter specifies the OneDrive sites to add to the list of included sites when you aren't using the value All for the OneDriveLocation parameter. You identify the site by its URL value.

claims.claim: The AddSharePointLocation and AddOneDriveLocation parameters add included sites when the corresponding location is not All.
claims.quote: The AddSharePointLocation parameter specifies the SharePoint sites to add to the list of included sites when you aren't using the value All for the SharePointLocation parameter.

claims.claim: Edit policy is documented for policies in Off or Simulation.
claims.quote:
For a policy in the Off section, select the Edit policy button.
For policy in the Simulation section, select the Edit policy option at the top of the page, from either tab.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance controls: row 2; Governance guidance
claims.claim: A policy can be turned on at Microsoft Purview portal > Solutions > Information Protection > Policies > Auto-labeling policies > policy > Turn on policy.
claims.quote: Sign in to the Microsoft Purview portal > Solutions > Information Protection > Policies > Auto-labeling policies. ... Select your policy to see the details ... When you're ready to run the policy without simulation, select the Turn on policy option.

claims.claim: Set-AutoSensitivityLabelPolicy -Identity <policy name> -Mode Enable enables policy actions and notifications.
claims.quote:
The Mode parameter specifies the action and notification level of the auto-labeling policy. Valid values are:
- Enable: The policy is enabled for actions and notifications.

claims.claim: TestWithoutNotifications is the simulation or test value for Mode.
claims.quote: TestWithoutNotifications: An audit mode where no actions are taken, and no notifications are sent (Test mode).
